shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

description: Search orders with Shopify search syntax, one page at a time.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

query.description: Shopify order search syntax, for example "status:open financial_status:paid", "tag:wholesale" or "created_at:>=2026-01-01". Leave empty to list all orders.

sort_key.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to the order id.

reverse.description: Return results in reverse sort order (for example newest first).

first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 40. Defaults to 40.

after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

description: List the fulfillment orders of an order: what still has to be shipped, from which location.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

query.description: Optional Shopify search syntax on the fulfillment orders, for example "status:open". Leave empty to list all.

first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 4. Defaults to 4.

after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

description: Get one fulfillment order with its status, holds, location and line items.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

fulfillment_order_id.description: The fulfillment order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/FulfillmentOrder/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillment_orders.

line_items_after.description: Leave empty for the first 50 line items. To read more, pass line_items_end_cursor from the previous call.

description: Mark items of a fulfillment order as shipped, with optional tracking details.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

fulfillment_order_id.description: The fulfillment order to fulfill, numeric or "gid://shopify/FulfillmentOrder/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillment_orders.

line_items.description: Optional partial shipment: the fulfillment order line items and quantities to ship. Leave empty to ship all remaining items of the fulfillment order.

fulfillment_order_line_item_id.description: The fulfillment order line item id from list_order_fulfillment_orders or get_fulfillment_order (line_items[].id), for example "gid://shopify/FulfillmentOrderLineItem/1234". This is not the order line item id.

quantity.description: How many units of this line item, 1 or more and at most its remaining_quantity.

tracking_company.description: The carrier name, for example "UPS", "USPS", "FedEx" or "DHL Express". With a supported carrier Shopify builds the tracking URL itself.

tracking_numbers.description: One or more tracking numbers, for example "1Z999AA10123456784".

tracking_urls.description: Tracking page URLs, one per tracking number, for example "https://www.ups.com/track?tracknum=1Z999AA10123456784". Only needed for carriers Shopify does not know.

notify_customer.description: Send the customer a shipping confirmation email. Off by default.

message.description: Optional internal message recorded with the fulfillment.

description: Change the carrier, tracking numbers or tracking URLs of a fulfillment.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

fulfillment_id.description: The fulfillment id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Fulfillment/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillments.

tracking_company.description: The carrier name, for example "UPS", "USPS", "FedEx" or "DHL Express".

tracking_numbers.description: The complete list of tracking numbers. Replaces the stored list; leave empty to keep it.

tracking_urls.description: The complete list of tracking page URLs, one per tracking number. Replaces the stored list; leave empty to keep it.

notify_customer.description: Send the customer a shipping update email. Off by default.

description: List the store's locations (warehouses, shops, fulfillment services), one page at a time.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

query.description: Shopify location search syntax, for example "name:Warehouse*". Leave empty to list all.

include_inactive.description: Also return deactivated locations. Off by default.

include_legacy.description: Also return legacy fulfillment-service locations. Off by default.

sort_key.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to the name.

reverse.description: Return results in reverse sort order (for example newest first).

first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 250. Defaults to 50.

after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

description: List stock quantities of one item across locations, or of all items at one location.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

inventory_item_id.description: List this item's levels at every location, numeric or "gid://shopify/InventoryItem/…". Leave empty when giving a location.

location_id.description: List every item stocked at this location, numeric or "gid://shopify/Location/…". Leave empty when giving an item.

include_inactive.description: Also return levels that were deactivated. Off by default.

first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 70. Defaults to 50.

after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

description: Get one inventory item with its SKU, cost, tracking and shipping details.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

inventory_item_id.description: The inventory item id, numeric or "gid://shopify/InventoryItem/…" (from get_product_variant_details).

description: Increase or decrease stock by a relative amount at one or more locations.

shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

name.description: Which quantity to adjust. Anything other than "available" needs a ledger document URI on each change.

reason.description: Why the stock changes; shown in the inventory history.

changes.description: One entry per inventory item and location.

inventory_item_id.description: The inventory item id, numeric or "gid://shopify/InventoryItem/…" (from get_product_variant_details).

location_id.description: The location id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Location/…" (from list_locations).

delta.description: Whole number to add (positive) or subtract (negative), for example -2.

expected_quantity.description: Optional safety check: the quantity you expect right now. The call fails if stock moved in the meantime.

ledger_document_uri.description: Required for quantity names other than "available": a non-Shopify URI, for example "gid://my-app/StockMovement/SM-1".

reference_document_uri.description: Optional URI of the document behind the change, for example "gid://my-app/PurchaseOrder/PO-1".

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this operation, for example a UUID such as "3f1c2a9e-6b1d-4c8e-9a51-2f7d0e4b8c10". Generate your own key on the first call and pass the same key again when retrying after a timeout or error, so Shopify does not repeat the operation. If left empty a key is generated; it is returned as idempotency_key and included in any error message.
